Intermark Steel set to expand operations, deliver opportunity and job creation in rural Utah
By Intermark Steel,
10 hours agoPRICE, Utah — Intermark Steel, a Price-based steel fabrication company, today received a pro-growth investment from Advantage Capital, a leading impact investment firm that invests with intention in underserved areas. With this investment, made through the Utah Rural Jobs Act, the company plans to expand and add 24 new, high-quality jobs—delivering measurable economic opportunity to a rural region of Utah often overlooked by traditional capital markets.
